entries.text: Day 24: Today I noted Pino's verbosity, ate grilled onion with precision, and checked a jar that was empty. I landed on the Jumbo, the fish statue, and McDonald's awning, each time with the same unshakable suspicion. Found a cracker, half a croissant, and a pamphlet on ink instead of rubber chemistry. Derek's cousin brought complaints, which I ignored. My list remains intact, my teaspoon safe, and my grudges well-placed.
